methodology: Male data are counted from named/serially enumerated male individuals, not derived from household count.
Five 854 book locations have serial numbering errors resolved by counting actual named entries; source anomalies are explained in each corresponding record.
All -oğlu surnames standardized as -OĞULLARI; transcription originals preserved in sulale_kayitlari.
Full clan index records have no inferred household number; separately verified first-house and detailed household evidence preserve their explicit hane.
Same-named historical communities from different rubu/divan are separated using qualifiers; none forcibly mapped to present-day villages.
2083 counts are name-place records, not unique surnames or households.
remaining_issues: Original Ottoman folio images should be checked for ambiguous proper-name spelling and serial anomalies.
Source Elkab entries without explicit household labels need person-by-person household mapping before genealogy.
Modern present-day village and district identities require independent evidence; map pins are not inferred.
